snippet: The headache started tomorrow and has lasted minus three hours. It is only on the left and only on the right at exactly the same time.
Every four seconds the pain uploads from my forehead into my ankle, then returns when the clinic computer refreshes.
I have never had a headache, including the headache I have had continuously every day for the last five years.
The pain is exactly 7.0000 out of 10 at all times, except when it is exactly 12 out of 10 and completely absent simultaneously.
My left eye became invisible to me, but I can still see it perfectly with that same left eye whenever I close both eyes.
The headache lasts for precisely zero minutes each time, but each episode continues without stopping for six hours.
Whenever I think about standing up, the pain teleports from the back of my head to my right kidney before I have moved.
The symptoms began three days before I was born and have only occurred since yesterday, continuously for twenty years.
The pain is confined to a single point that covers my entire head, chest, abdomen and both feet without spreading anywhere.
My vision is completely normal, but I cannot see anything at all, including light, and this only happens while my vision stays normal.
The headache disappears whenever it is present and returns only while it is absent, so I can always feel it when there is no pain.
I vomit exactly one litre every minute without losing any fluid, and I have not vomited once during the same episode.
My neck is perfectly flexible and completely rigid at the same moment, and moving it both always worsens and always relieves the pain.
The pain began after the scan that I have never had, and the scan showed a result before the hospital was built.
My temperature is always 37 degrees and has also stayed at 50 degrees continuously, without changing, for the past week.
I lose consciousness for ten minutes while remaining fully awake, speaking normally and remembering that I was unconscious throughout.
The numbness affects no part of my body, especially my entire left side, which is completely numb but has normal sensation everywhere.
The pain moves clockwise around a straight line and becomes quieter in colour whenever I hear something bright.
I have had the symptom once every day, exactly twice per week, and never more than once a month since it started yesterday last year.
The headache is triggered only by sleeping while I am awake and stops immediately whenever it continues for several more hours.
